Class OrinSolver

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.subsystems.vision.OrinSolver
public final class OrinSolver extends Object
Turns one Orin camera's logged PhotonLib results into pose observations. Reads only OrinCameraInputs and robot state that is itself replayed, so it runs identically live and in replay (issue #10, section 2).
  • Multi-tag: the Jetson's multi-tag solve (estimatedPose.best). Tag count and distance come from fiducialIDsUsed, not every visible target (section 10a).
  • Single tag: the lowest-ambiguity usable tag. Of its two PnP candidates, the one whose heading is closest to the gyro's at the frame's timestamp (6328, section 8b); the ambiguity gate in VisionGates.orinGates(DoubleSupplier) then drops frames where the two are too alike.
  • Targets with fiducialId < 0 (game pieces), tags missing from the layout and tags on the excluded list (section 12) are never used. The Jetson already leaves excluded tags out of multi-tag; this keeps them out of the single-tag path too.
  • Each observation's std-dev scale is the camera's factor times edgeScale(PhotonTrackedTarget): tags near the image edge are trusted less, not dropped (section 8b).

  • Constructor Details

    • OrinSolver

      public OrinSolver(Transform3d robotToCamera, AprilTagFieldLayout layout, double cameraFactor, int imageWidth, int imageHeight)
      Parameters:
      robotToCamera - camera mount, robot frame (x forward, y left, z up)
      layout - the field's AprilTags; must match the Jetson's
      cameraFactor - per-camera std-dev multiplier (6328's camera factor)
      imageWidth - image width in px (the Jetson's images are 1280x800)
      imageHeight - image height in px

    • solve

      public List<PoseObservation> solve(OrinCameraInputs inputs, Set<Integer> excludedTags, DoubleFunction<Rotation2d> headingAt)
      Solves every logged result.
      Parameters:
      inputs - this loop's camera inputs
      excludedTags - tag ids to leave out (section 12)
      headingAt - the robot's heading at a capture time, or null if unknown (before the pose is seeded); picks between single-tag candidates
      Returns:
      one observation per result that had a usable tag

    • edgeScale

      public double edgeScale(org.photonvision.targeting.PhotonTrackedTarget t)
      1.0 away from the image edges, rising smoothly to EDGE_MAX_SCALE as the tag's closest corner reaches an edge. Near the edge lens distortion is strongest, the calibration has the least data, and tags are often cut off.
